newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GIO in Indian funds, broking venture.
newsitem.headline: GIO in Indian funds, broking venture.

text.p: Insurance group GIO Australia Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had formed a joint venture with Indian industrial group Chemplast Sanmar Ltd to set up a funds management, fixed interest broking and bond trading operation in Madras.
GIO said under the agreement, two new companies will be set up and equally owned by GIO Australia and Sanmar. The joint venture had been approved by India's Foreign Investment Permission Board.

"We also have an agreement in principle with the Sanmar Group to set up a joint venture general insurance company when the general insurance market in India is deregulated," GIO chairman John Iliffe told the group's annual meeting.
GIO said the timing of the deregulation was uncertain.
GIO said it was also in discussions with possible joint venture partners in Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines.
